title: Domestic transition without identical wishes

captions.physics: Ending outdated domestic forms and procedures
captions.energy: Testing closeness through completely matching choices
captions.emotions: Feeling changes in circumstances and responses

meaning: Your domestic support keeps its flexibility when ending the familiar allows different responses instead of both simultaneously wanting every part of change identically.
text: You can create support by ending the outdated: releasing an unnecessary procedure, removing a form no longer useful and changing participation. Death in the physical position of Muladhara describes these actions. The Lovers in energy complicate them through demanding completely matching wishes. The Wheel of Fortune in emotions feels changing circumstances and responses. Transition can wait despite agreement. Both understand the need, but moods change and every response supposedly tests afresh whether ending the earlier domestic method was sufficiently shared.

For example, you remove a large dining table for a freer room. One enjoys it immediately while the other adjusts to changed space although also willing. **Different rhythms of experience do not cancel a freely shared choice.** You can name present feeling and examine actual convenience. An ending supports different living without a changing response proving or disproving closeness daily through how identically both react to the new domestic form.

The difficulty is restoring the previous arrangement to recover matching moods. Conditions have changed while agreement continually depends on current emotional confirmation. Distinguishing consent from experience offers more dependable support: both can be clarified separately. Transition preserves clear participation and the right to gradually become familiar with newness without making each feeling immediately determine the entire shared decision’s future. Agreement can remain active while responses develop through use.
